text:
harper: Kicking off region-by-region roll for v3.13. Plan: US -> EU -> APAC. Soft-pin canaries, quick verification, then ramp. Start at :15 UTC.

deploy-bot: preflight summary:
• warm-pools: us=4 eu=2 apac=1
• quotas: token-buckets OK
• canary slices: us=1.0%, eu=0.5%, apac=0.15%
• rollback rules: auto-rollback on error_rate>0.5% (5m) or p95>400ms (3m) or infra_temp>78C

mira: US warm-pool warmed, KV cache primed, mini-eval green.

deploy-bot: executing ->
```
deploy --region=us --image=v3.13 --slice=1.0 --strategy=soft-pin --warm-pool=4
```

leo: US canary ingestion steady, p95=110ms, error=0.02%. Looks good.

op-bot: (monitor) set alert thresholds: p95>300ms, infra_temp>76C

deploy-bot: US promoted to 10% at +12m after stability check.

harper: Holdpoint for 20m post-promote. If no regressions, proceed to 50% then full.

jon: small anomaly: one evaluation prompt returned higher token delta vs baseline. Filed eval-321. Not blocking.

deploy-bot: US ramped to 50% at +25m. p95=145ms, cost within band.

mira: Re-run smoke tests for rare prompts — all pass.

harper: EU prep starting during US hold. We'll keep EU slice small and validate cross-region routing.

deploy-bot: starting EU canary ->
```
deploy --region=eu --image=v3.13 --slice=0.5 --strategy=soft-pin --warm-pool=2
```

leo: EU canary live. Observability: minor tokenization diff in locale test (low impact).

op-bot: eu warm-pool health OK. Preemptible capacity available for short bursts.

deploy-bot: EU promoted to 5% at +20m. p95=165ms, error rate=0.04%.

harper: Good. We plan to full-pin EU after verification at +60m mark.

infra-bot: APAC warm-pool limited (ap-south=1). Suggested fallback route to eu for heavy queries.

mira: Given ap-south constraints we'll attempt micro-canary 0.15% with strict limits. If thermal or latency thresholds breach, flip to eu fallback (v3.12-stable).

deploy-bot: starting APAC micro-canary ->
```
deploy --region=apac --image=v3.13 --slice=0.15 --strategy=soft-pin --warm-pool=1
```

op-bot: ap-south gpu temp rose to 77C after 4m. Auto-pause triggered; routing set to eu fallback.

leo: Apac observed p95 spike to 430ms before pause. Logs show retry spikes.

harper: Good pause. No roll forward in APAC. We'll either expand warm-pool or reattempt via ap-east.

jon: Opening infra ticket to request extra on-demand instances in ap-east (ticket INF-842). ETA ~30m.

mira: Update release notes draft to reflect APAC hold and fallback behavior. Include rollback criteria and contact points.

deploy-bot: release-note snippet:
"v3.13: perf and quantization tweaks. Rollout status: US (ramped), EU (partial), APAC (micro-canary paused — traffic routed to v3.12-stable in EU). See internal runbook for pin/unpin and fallback rules"

harper: Action items:
• jon -> follow infra ticket and confirm ap-east capacity (ETA 30m)
• leo -> verify fallback correctness under eu routing for APAC-origin traffic
• mira -> finalize release note and update rollout board
• ops-bot -> continuous thermal/watch alerts until APAC resolved

op-bot: Note saved: auto-pause reason = "infra_temp_threshold_exceeded".

harper: We'll reconvene at +35m to decide reattempt or defer APAC to maintenance window. If ap-east capacity is available, reattempt with 0.1% slice and ap-east preference.

leo: Posting canary logs and metric dashboards to #eng-releases-artifacts for audit.

mira: Quick reminder: If we defer APAC, we must tag customers in APAC region with expected update delay. I'll prepare comms template.

harper: Thanks team. Leaving US/EU tasks to auto-close once EU reaches full-pin at +90m. Thread stays canonical for tonight's rollout decisions. :white_check_mark:
